description: A CodeTour tour of one linked change, stored with bl tour ID FILE (- reads stdin), MCP tour (file or inline tour), or an action or hook result {"tour": PATH}. bl instructions tours explains how to write one.

ref.description: Full SHA of the change's head commit. A tour whose ref heads no linked change is refused.

file.description: Repository-relative path with / separators, without . or .. segments.

line.description: 1-based line in the file at ref, or before the change when side is old. With selection, it must equal selection.start.line.

selection.description: A range of whole lines, on side, of at most 500 lines. Characters are accepted and ignored.

description.description: Markdown narrative shown above the line.

criterion.description: 1-based index of the item's acceptance criterion this step satisfies.

side.description: old for a line before the change: a deleted line or a renamed file's old path.
